versions.summary: Adds Blood Debt, a high-risk delayed-damage spell, and changes Boots to 20% / 40% / 60% movement speed.

versions.name: Ju’s Ricochet & Guardian Angel
versions.author: @Biousere
versions.summary: Adds Ricochet, a ball that bounces off the pillars and off an invisible wall at the lava’s edge, and the Guardian Angel, a secret item that refuses your death and stands you back up on half health.
